purpose: Test whether one additional conservative near-water-table storage state can retain the local hydraulic information supported by BC2-B4 after the storage-only zero-added-state reconstruction failed in BC2-B5.
scientific_logic: B4 shows that local pressure-head information close to H improves qH in both movement directions.
B5 shows that the same information cannot be recovered robustly from the existing single moving-layer storage Wm and geometry L using the preregistered mass-consistent linear reconstruction.
B6 therefore tests the minimum next state enrichment: one extra conservative terminal storage band adjacent to H.

geometry.excluded_width_20cm_reason: 20 cm does not remain inside the moving 90..H layer over the already-qualified H range; exclusion is geometric and frozen before B6 response.

added_state.restart_semantics: Candidate state is (Wb,Wt,H) for a frozen d. No point head, profile moment, fitted coefficient or hidden full-order state is retained.
added_state.moving_internal_boundary: H-d moves with H; B6 is projection/operator diagnosis only and does not yet authorize its dynamic conservation law.

reference_projection.source: qualified BC2-A2 accepted pressure-head profiles and moving-layer storage
reference_projection.H: same strict interior zero-pressure crossing used in BC2-A2/B3/B4/B5
reference_projection.pressure_reconstruction: piecewise-linear interpolation of accepted pressure head h(z), with h(H)=0 by the diagnosed crossing

candidate_flux.interpretation: standard published LARE water-table face closure applied to the added terminal storage layer
candidate_flux.conductivity: Ks at the zero-pressure water table

comparators: POINT_2_5CM from B4, diagnostic full-order local-information benchmark only

hard_gates.constitutive_domain: theta_r < theta_t < theta_s unless exact saturated endpoint is analytically handled

adjudication.moving_support_rule: A frozen width supports terminal-state enrichment only when its RMS and mean-absolute qH errors are both lower than MOVING_LAYER_AVERAGE and LINEAR_STORAGE, and its sign-mismatch count is no greater than either comparator, in both WATER_TABLE_RISING and WATER_TABLE_FALLING strata.
adjudication.hold_rule: The same width must be noninferior to LINEAR_STORAGE on RMS, mean-absolute error and sign mismatch in HOLD.
adjudication.width_selection_rule: A preferred frozen width is declared only if it is component-wise minimum or tied minimum for RMS and mean-absolute error in both moving directions and HOLD among widths satisfying the support rules. Otherwise state enrichment may be supported with width unresolved.
adjudication.local_information_gap: POINT_2_5CM is reported only to quantify remaining information gap and cannot be selected as reduced-state input.
